user.title: KampKlar
user.description: Log in with your DBU credentials

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {username} has expired. Enter a new password.

init.title: Options
init.description: How often activities are refreshed, and when calendar events start.

data.start_at_meeting_time: Start calendar events at the meeting time

data_description.start_at_meeting_time: When an activity has a meeting time, its calendar event starts then and the description shows the real start. Sensors keep the real start.

tilmeld.name: Sign up
tilmeld.description: Sign a tracked child up for an activity. Pick the child; leave the activity empty to use their next activity.

device_id.name: Child
device_id.description: The child's KampKlar device. You can pick several children.

activity_id.name: Activity ID
activity_id.description: Optional. The activity to sign up for (activity_id on the child's sensors). Defaults to the child's next activity.

person_id.name: Person ID
person_id.description: Optional alternative to choosing the child as the target.

afmeld.name: Sign off
afmeld.description: Sign a tracked child off an activity. Pick the child; leave the activity empty to use their next activity.

device_id.name: Child
device_id.description: The child's KampKlar device. You can pick several children.

activity_id.name: Activity ID
activity_id.description: Optional. The activity to sign off from. Defaults to the child's next activity.

person_id.name: Person ID
person_id.description: Optional alternative to choosing the child as the target.
